scoringMethod.note: IG-2 is an offline evaluation of hand-authored golden cases and a deterministic compiler, not a live-LLM-judged pipeline (no API calls are made in this phase). Soft scores for the 18 golden cases in tower-golden-cases.json are assigned by the same reviewer who authored them, recorded in reports/tower-offline-evaluation.md, and are self-consistency scores (do the golden examples meet the rubric they were written to satisfy), not blind third-party ratings. This limitation is stated explicitly in the evaluation report and is an open question for IG-3 (see docs/INTERPRETATION_GRAPH_EVALUATION_V1.md).
scoringMethod.concisionRule: primaryInterpretation must be 35-90 Turkish words, alternativePerspective (if present) 15-45 words, total <=140 words — scored 2 only if within these bounds AND not repetitive.
scoringMethod.synthesisQualityRule: scored 0 if the text reads as position/context/signal sentences concatenated verbatim from the graph JSON rather than rewritten into one voice.
